title: Integral representing pair reconstructed from a supplied exceptional system
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p$, and a $k$-morphism $f:X\to Y$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, valuation ring $R$, uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Choose a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{g}Y)$, with $j$ open and $g$ proper [def-weil-compactifications-refinements].

For $T=X,\overline X,Y$, let $\mathsf S_T^{\mathrm{et}}$ and $\mathsf S_T^{\mathrm{proet}}$ be the abelian categories of strict systems of $(A_n)_T$-module sheaves on the indicated small sites, with semilinear quotient transitions and componentwise exactness; use their ordinary unbounded derived categories and exact evaluations $e_n$ [lem-pur-coefficient-system-derived-comparison]. Put $F^{\mathrm{et}}=Rg_{*,\bullet}^{\mathrm{et}}j_{!,\bullet}^{\mathrm{et}}$ and $F_n^{\mathrm{et}}=Rg_{*,n}^{\mathrm{et}}j_{!,n}^{\mathrm{et}}$.

Put $\widehat R_T=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_T$ and let $\mathcal I_T(R)$ be the completed integral constructible category [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Use the actual reduction/total-limit adjunction $\mathcal R_T\dashv\mathcal L_T$, $\mathcal L_T=R\varprojlim\operatorname{Res}$, with unit $u$ and counit $e$ [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Let $P_R:\mathcal I_X(R)\to\mathcal I_Y(R)$ be compact-support reconstruction, with its actual system comparison $\alpha_K:\mathcal R_Y P_RK\xrightarrow{\sim}F\mathcal R_XK$, where $F=Rg_{*,\bullet}j_{!,\bullet}$ on pro-etale towers [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization]. Fix $L\in\mathcal I_Y(R)$ and write $L_n=e_n\mathcal R_YL$. Let $G(C)=\nu_{X,\bullet}^*G^{\mathrm{et}}R\nu_{Y,\bullet,*}C$ be the bounded-below transported Brown functor of [lem-pur-brown-tower-finite-site-comparison] on inputs whose outputs are bounded below, and put $N=G(\mathcal R_YL)$. Suppose $M_\bullet$ is an ordinary normalized pro-etale derived system with intrinsically constructible finite-level cohomology in a common finite interval and specified isomorphisms $\phi_n:M_n\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_n^!L_n$ intertwining the actual quotient-transition adjoints. Require either (a) a specified isomorphism $\theta:M_\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}N$ evaluating to $\phi_n$ under the canonical comparisons, or (b) an integer $r$ such that every $M_n$ has cohomology only in degree $r$. Suppose $M=\mathcal L_XM_\bullet\in\mathcal I_X(R)$ and that its canonical reductions agree with $M_n$.

In case (b) there is a canonical isomorphism $\theta$ in the ordinary derived category of systems, evaluating to $\phi_n$, induced by the strict cohomology-system isomorphism $H^r(M_\bullet)\cong H^r(N)$ under the functorial good-truncation identifications with those systems placed in degree $r$. For any two such data sets concentrated in the same degree, level-identification squares imply the square of these actual system maps.

In both cases there are $R$-linear bijections, natural in every $K\in\mathcal I_X(R)$,
$$\operatorname{Hom}_X(K,M)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}_Y(P_RK,L).$$
They are induced by the actual reduction/total-limit adjunction, $\theta$, the transported Brown adjunction and $\alpha_K$. The image $t:P_RM\to L$ of $1_M$ has reduction, conjugated by $\alpha_M$, equal as an actual ordinary system map to
$$F\mathcal R_XM\xrightarrow{F e_{M_\bullet}}FM_\bullet\xrightarrow{F\theta}FN\xrightarrow{\epsilon}\mathcal R_YL.$$
In particular $t_n=\epsilon_n\circ F_n(\phi_n)$ under the canonical reduction identifications. These bijections and $t$ are natural in a map of integral inputs together with an actual map of supplied derived systems commuting with their Brown identifications. The assertion is representability at this supplied $L$, and assumes no global constructible integral right adjoint.

source.place: Agent ordinary-derived refinement of the displayed integral Hom chain and its unit/counit normalization; returned item proof Steps 6–7, including the alternative single-degree system recognition.

proof.text: Construct the coordinate Family from the supplied exceptional systems, using uniform-Tor reduction, normalized reconstruction, Brown transport and shifted-heart recognition.
Use the canonical supportPresentation beta. Naturality and the equivalence triangle give the actual-system alpha_transport equation.

Compose the coordinate Hom linear equivalence with Linear.homCongr for supportPresentation and the induced-category Hom linear equivalence. Naturality of the presentation proves hom_natural and transports input and trace naturality. Cancel beta and the reduction of the presentation to rewrite the coordinate alpha via alpha_transport. This gives trace_reduction; functoriality of evaluation and the coordinate finite trace give trace_evaluation. Assemble these fields with the coordinate Family into PublishedFamily.

proof_origin.place: Displayed integral Hom chain and final unit/counit paragraph; refinement of representing-pair Steps 1--7.
